content.en: The **International Labour Organization (ILO)** is the only tripartite UN agency, bringing together representatives of governments, employers, and workers. Its primary objective is to advance opportunities for women and men to obtain decent and productive work in conditions of freedom, equity, security, and human dignity. In the context of the **Indian Economy**, the ILO serves as a benchmark for labor reforms, influencing the transition from informal to formal employment.
